scientific_integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by exact and sampled reproducibility checks. The general dynamical conclusion is not inferred from sampling.
scientific_limitations: Assumes unweighted identical sinusoidal coupling and n not divisible by four.
The n^-1/2 law is for the antiphase basin off the eventual strong-stable leaf, not for arbitrary orbits.
Historical priority is provisional; full independent scientific validation is outstanding.
title: Critical-endpoint convergence and parabolic antiphase relaxation on Huygens cycles
